ai_analysis.summary: The post is a personal SQL interview preparation list. The author claims that 20 focused problems were sufficient instead of solving more than 300 LeetCode problems. Eighteen exercises are visible, covering topics such as combining tables, comparing employee and manager earnings, finding and deleting duplicate emails, finding customers who never ordered, temperature comparisons, bonuses, customer referees, countries, classes, salary swapping, and product, project, and sales analysis. Each exercise is represented only by a title and link; no schemas, SQL code, solutions, or explanations are included. The numbering skips 9 and 17, and the post is truncated at "see more."
